positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Orchestrated end-to-end integration of UPS and FedEx REST APIs into our bespoke ERP, driving the entire feature from backend processing—including automatic shipping label generation—to front-end development of user interfaces for box sizing, price estimation, etc, resulted in receiving official UPS API certification 

Integrated contactless credit card reading into our mobile app allowing automated parsing and reading of credit card information based on EMV payment method (ISO/IEC 14443 standard) through NFC

Spearheaded the development of key SaaS features, including SMS based marketing functionality by using Twilio’s and WhatsApp APIs resulting in a 20% increase in vendor response rates

Collaborated closely with QA to refine Ionic/Angular mobile app deployment processes, establishing best practices that enhanced version release efficiency and ensured seamless integration of new features
positions.insights: Skills: Java · Python · Web Development · Object-Oriented Programming (OOP) · C# · Vue.js · SQL · MongoDB

positions.title: Software Developer/Engineer
positions.description:
Automated the generation of business data reports (Inventory, Sales, etc), with Python and Google Drive/Sheets/Docs APIs, which saved over 80 working hours daily across selected sales teams

Designed a distributed web crawler, automating Amazon product review requests using Python to scrape order information and request reviews directly through Amazon, which lead to a 300% increase in review ratings left by customers

Developed (Tquens) an online SaaS ERP platform tailored for E-Commerce, enabling data visualizations which allowed for data-driven decisions to be made by the end-user. Internal usage metrics indicated an 8% increase in Amazon buy box selections in the first quarter 

Utilized Amazon’s MWS API in conjunction with AWS SQS to automate the creation of product listings
Automated data integration from E-commerce (Ebay, Amazon, Shopify) APIs into an Oracle database using a custom ETL pipeline, streamlining order, sales, and inventory management
positions.insights: Skills: Java · Python · Web Development · Object-Oriented Programming (OOP) · C# · SQL · MongoDB

projects.title: Generating Novel Images with Generative Adversarial Networks
projects.description:
I implemented a Deep Convolutional Generative Adversarial Neural Network with TensorFlow and Keras to generate new realistic
images based on a given dataset. 
The network learns the high-level feature sets of the database; for example, learning what a nose, eye, face all are in a higher-level sense rather than just copying and pasting pixels. 
The network architecture is based on a generative adversarial model, where two networks, a critic and a forger, produce and judge "fakes" based on the database of images. The critic is trained directly through the database while the forger generates random examples for the critic to judge. The forger is trained by the results the critic returns.

projects.title: Dungeon Dash
projects.description: Dungeon Dash is a competitive maze creator and runner game designed specifically for the virtualization wall at Connecticut College. 2 players build and design mazes and are pitted against the other's maze design and their own. The first to finish both mazes wins.
